answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 6905 Country: India Title: I would like to know about the E-codes.some eatables contain these E-codes.i have heard that the indian products with E-codes contain pig fat, is this true? Question: asaalamualaikum, I would like to know about the E-codes.some eatables contain these E-codes.i have heard that the indian products with E-codes contain pig fat, is this true? Answer ID: 6905 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1276/1198=D/1429) We are not sure of it. Until it is not proved with surety that these things contain pig fat, there shall not be applied any ruling of haram on the basis of doubt only. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
